description: This file defines test configuration patterns and categorizations for a project, including patterns for unit tests, boundary tests, and plugin-dependent tests. It sets up patterns to identify specific test files and exclude certain directories, facilitating automated testing processes.

methods.name: isUnitConfigTestFile
methods.description: Determines if a given file matches the patterns for unit configuration test files, considering inclusion and exclusion patterns.

methods.name: isBundledPluginDependentUnitTestFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is part of the bundled plugin dependent unit test files based on predefined list.

methods.name: isBoundaryTestFile
methods.description: Checks if a file matches any of the boundary test file patterns.
